scope: Read-only source and retained snapshot inspection for report presentation.
essential_header_fields: Release work item ID and source link
reference_patterns: Compact release identity and metadata replace a full field table.
Compliance appears as a status summary with expandable evidence cards.
Work items use a dense table with test and defect status badges.
Builds use two-column repository cards with branch checks and coverage tiles.
Failed comparison badges expose a specific count-based reason.

branch.source_issue_rule: Either aheadCount or behindCount is nonzero.

main.source_issue_rule: behindCount exceeds zero, unless the supplied merge-only exemption applies.

production.source_issue_rule: behindCount exceeds zero, unless the supplied merge-only exemption applies.

main_production.source_issue_rule: changeCounts contains changes, unless the supplied merge-only exemption applies.

proposed_information_architecture.content: Compact title, work item ID, date, state, change ID, and direct Clinic report action.
Attention summary with failed checks first. Each row names the entity, reason, and detail destination.
Small counts for components, work items, failed checks, and missing evidence. Avoid invented pass totals.
Repository build cards with result badge, candidate branch, comparison findings, and two coverage metrics.
Collapsed work item, test, defect, quality, relationship, and collection evidence sections.

presentation_rules: Use a neutral light page, bounded content width, restrained borders, consistent spacing, and small status badges.
Keep failure reasons readable without hover, tooltips, or opening raw JSON.
Place unavailable evidence separately from explicit failed checks.
Keep raw fields, request logs, hashes, graph records, and metrics inside closed evidence details.
Use native details and summary elements for keyboard operation without JavaScript.
Keep links to separate Clinic HTML. Do not copy the supplied inline compliance implementation.
Preserve all data in the snapshot even when the summary displays only essential fields.
limits: The supplied UI uses React host components that are absent from the standalone runtime.
The source merge-only exemption flags are absent from the current normalized snapshot.
Missing comparison counts must remain unknown. The source coerces some absent counts to success.
The mock snapshot has completed collection but still contains test failures and open defects.
This inspection does not establish business approval, deployed behavior, or a new coverage gate.
limitations: Automated checks do not check the complete approved dictionary or grammar rules.
